<article title="Returns and exchanges">
You can return or exchange unworn items with their tags attached within 60 days of delivery. Start the return from the Orders page, choose the items, and print the prepaid return label. Exchanges for a different size or color ship as soon as the carrier scans your return package.

Items marked final sale, and safety equipment such as climbing hardware, cannot be returned once opened.

Return shipping is free for exchanges. For refunds, a flat 7 dollar label fee is deducted unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

</article>

Customer first name: Mateo
<request>
return part of my order
i want to return one of the three items in my order and keep the rest. do i have to send back the whole package?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for reaching out. You can return individual items: from the Orders page, choose only the item you want to send back and print the prepaid return label. You don't need to return the whole order.

Please note that the item must be unworn with its tags attached, and returned within 60 days of delivery. Also, for refunds, a flat $7 label fee is deducted unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
